title: United Nations Secretariat Building with Flags, 1956 NYC B&W Snapshot Photo
location: New York City, New York, United States
description: A low-angle view of the modernist United Nations Secretariat Building towering over the Manhattan skyline, bordered by a line of fluttering member nation flags along First Avenue. Completed in 1952 by an international committee of architects including Le Corbusier and Oscar Niemeyer, the skyscraper stood as a prime symbol of post-WWII internationalism and mid-century modern architecture during the height of the Cold War. Landscaped hedges and ornate security fencing sit in the lower foreground. The print features classic deckled scalloped borders and a right-margin date stamp reading 'JUN · 56'.
